atlas_layout: Top half front, bottom half blank reverse; two landscape 3:2 faces
postprocessing: Byte-identical copies of generated outputs. No raster editing, resizing or painted-over native artwork.

border.content_basis: Header, time and signatory come from the existing story. The failure and batteries lines are concise renderings of its stated events/dialogue, not additional lore.

radio.content_basis: Existing emergency channel and timestamps; short faithful summaries of the canonical log entries. No invented callsign, organization or date.

surface_text: I left the compass in the blue cup.
North is still north, even here.
leena.content_basis: Canonical salutation and excerpts; the compass sentence ends before the original subordinate clause. No invented sender signature.

tampere.content_basis: Existing salutation, first sentence and closing. No invented town/date line or other family details.

mesh_workflow: Isolated Godot UV-buffer-only derivative of the accepted original Blender geometry. Existing Blender files and the Hamina runtime mesh are not changed.
generator_deviations: Requested 1536x2048; returned 1086x1448 with the exact intended 3:4 aspect ratio.
Generated center crease and subtle outer-edge shading are excluded by the inset front/back UV ranges; original pixels are retained.
limits: Artwork supplies pickup identity, not the full localized reader content.
UV-only derivative requires its own runtime path; do not replace the original Hamina mesh or albedo.
Native offline lighting is not actual Windows in-game acceptance.
record_scope: Curated historical origin summary; raw scenes, intermediary images and local QA are not distributed. See art_source/README.md for the current runtime source boundary.
